quotes: ~2,000 new subscription apps launched per month in Jan 2022; 14,700+ by Jan 2026.
apps launched before 2020 generate 69% of all subscription revenue.
Apps launched in 2025 or later (aka, the vibe coding era) account for just 3%.
Cross-category median is ~$72, but the top 10% pull $2,500+, a 36× gap
AI-powered apps generate 41% more revenue per payer, but they churn 30% faster.
Vertical, opinionated products beat thin AI wrappers. (Olivia Moore, Andreessen Horowitz, 보고서 안 인터뷰 요약)
